data.title: Imperial Petroleum Inc. Declares Dividend on Series A Preferred Shares
data.description: Athens, Greece - On September 12, 2026, Imperial Petroleum Inc. (Nasdaq: IMPP) revealed a dividend declaration of $0.546875 per share on its 8.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock (Series A Preferred Shares). This dividend is set to be paid on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 25, 2026. The payment covers the period from the preceding dividend payment date for the Series A Preferred Shares on June 30, 2026, through September 29, 2026. Imperial Petroleum Inc. is a ship-owning company offering petroleum products, crude oil, and drybulk seaborne transportation services.

data.title: ArrowMark Financial Corp. Announces Q2 Results and Special Distribution of $0.10 and Monthly Cash Distribution of $0.15 per Share for September 2026
data.description: On September 11, 2026, ArrowMark Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: BANX) announced a special cash distribution of $0.10 per share from excess income, along with a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.15 per share for September 2026. The total distribution of $0.15 per share is set to be paid on September 30, 2026, to shareholders recorded on September 23, 2026. Additionally, the special distribution will be paid on December 31, 2026, to shareholders recorded on December 24, 2026. ArrowMark Financial is a closed-end management investment company registered with the SEC.

data.title: Eastern International Ltd. Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notification Regarding Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description: On September 10, 2026, Eastern International Ltd. (NASDAQ: ELOG), a company based in Hangzhou, China, specializing in professional logistics and construction services, received notice from the Nasdaq Stock Market. The letter stated that due to the closing bid price of the company's ordinary shares consistently falling below $1.00 for 30 consecutive trading days, Eastern International no longer complies with the Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing. The Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) mandates a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share for listing, which the company currently fails to meet.

data.title: Kentucky American Water Completes Major Infrastructure Improvement Projects on North Limestone, Euclid and Fontaine
data.description: In a recent announcement on September 11, 2026, Kentucky American Water revealed the successful conclusion of their water main replacement initiatives in the North Limestone-Euclid-Fontaine regions of Lexington. data.title: EscapeSquid Pursues $2.5 Million Seed Round to Scale Virtual-to-Destination Fitness and Travel Platform

data.title: Trilogy Metals Closes US$35.6 Million Strategic Equity Investment by the U.S. Department of War
data.description: The U.S. government has acquired a 10% stake in Trilogy Metals, a mining company operating in Alaska's Ambler Mining District. This move aims to boost the domestic copper supply. This development was announced in Vancouver, BC, on September 11, 2026. Trilogy Metals Inc., listed on NYSE American as TMQ and on TSX as TMQ, now sees the government as a significant shareholder.

data.title: BIMBO BAKERIES TEAMSTERS OVERWHELMINGLY RATIFY CONTRACT
data.description: More than 200 employees in the New England region successfully avoided a strike by securing a robust contract. Teamsters Local 170 and Local 633 at Bimbo Bakeries reached an agreement with a staggering 90% approval rate. The new deal comes after negotiations earlier this month involving sales and warehouse workers.

data.title: LV Petroleum Welcomes Jamie Hubbard as SVP Construction and Maintenance

The announcement was made in Las Vegas on September 11, 2026. Hubbard's extensive industry experience is expected to contribute significantly to the company's operations as it moves forward.
